addr: #57/1 Monarch Plaza Brigade Road, Off, Mahatma Gandhi Rd, Bengaluru, Karnataka 560001, India

rev.t: Good market place for all things necessary for baking cake... Decoration of Christmas items available here... …

Very Disappointing experience at this store Staff seemed unwelcoming and behaved as if they owned me, even suggesting I shouldn't purchase anything. Not the kind of service one expects from a grocery store. Won't be returning.

I paid on google pay to the same account I had bought things from the same shop, but the cashier said I have to do it again. So I had to leave the items I had paid for in the shop. What kind of payment system is this???
